answer: Two WCAG 2.2 criteria set target size. 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum) (level AA) requires pointer targets to be at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels, with exceptions. 2.5.5 Target Size (Enhanced) (level AAA) raises the bar to at least 44 by 44 CSS pixels.

points.text: For the AA minimum (2.5.8), targets must be at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels, unless an exception applies.
points.quote: The size of the target for pointer inputs is at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels
points.title: 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum)

points.text: A smaller target is acceptable under 2.5.8 if spacing keeps a 24-pixel circle around it from touching other targets.
points.quote: the circles do not intersect another target or the circle for another undersized target
points.title: 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum)

points.text: For the AAA enhanced level (2.5.5), custom targets should be at least 44 by 44 pixels.
points.quote: Make custom targets at least 44 by 44 pixels.
points.title: 2.5.5 Target Size (Enhanced)
points.source_text:
Goal:
Controls can be operated more easily, especially on touchscreens.
What to do:
Make custom targets at least 44 by 44 pixels.
Why it's important:
Some people cannot tap small objects.

points.text: Larger sizes are recommended for controls used often, hard to undo, hard to reach, or part of a sequential task.
points.quote: it is recommended that larger sizes are used to reduce the possibility of unintentional actions
points.title: 2.5.5 Target Size (Enhanced)
